gloss: firstly; first of all; in the first place

definitions.gloss: firstly; first of all; in the first place
definitions.explanation: Used to introduce the first point in a series of arguments or reasons. Also used to emphasize that something is the most important consideration.

examples.japanese: {第一|だいいち}に、⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: First of all, please confirm safety.

examples.japanese: {第一|だいいち}に⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧、⟦{第二|だいに}に→第二に：19916_dainini⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Health comes first, family comes second.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。{第一|だいいち}に⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: There are problems with this plan. First of all, the budget is insufficient.

notes:
{第一|だいいち}に introduces the first and often most important point in a series. It is used in logical arguments, speeches, and essays.

SERIES PATTERN:
Often used with sequential markers:
- {第一|だいいち}に (firstly)
- ⟦{第二|だいに}に→第二に：19916_dainini⟧ (secondly)
- {第三|だいさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (thirdly)

WITHOUT に:
⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧ alone (without ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) emphasizes priority: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧ (health first), ⟦{安全|あんぜん}{第一|だいいち}→安全第一：24120_anzendaiichi⟧ (safety first).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧: first, to begin with (more colloquial and versatile)
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at first, initially (temporal focus)
- ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: above all else (strongest emphasis on priority)
- ⟦そもそも→そもそも：05211_somosomo⟧: in the first place (challenges premises, more confrontational)

REGISTER:
Neutral to formal. Common in structured arguments and formal writing. In casual speech, ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧ is preferred.
